uncertainty: The local official registry evidence is procedural/custodian context and does not demonstrate an anonymous current parcel geometry feed.
The official public viewer was inspected through its current HTML, JavaScript, map configuration, and service-metadata POST route; the exposed services were basemap/platform resources only.

One initial HTML retrieval used curl -k during reconnaissance; it was not used to qualify any source or retain data. Subsequent requests used normal TLS verification. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe fields were used.
No parcel sample is retained because no safe native parcel ID plus full polygon response was obtained.
